list.description: Everyone working for your occasion: where each booking stands, what you agreed and what is next to pay.
list.emptyBody: Add your first supplier — the band, the restaurant, the photographer — and follow the booking, the briefing and the payments from here.
list.emptyBodyReadOnly: When the planner adds suppliers, you will see them here.
list.briefingAcked: Briefing v{version} · acknowledged by the supplier

booking.title: Booking state
booking.cancelledNote: The booking is cancelled. You can reopen it at any time.

terms.title: What you agreed
terms.agreedHint: Leave it empty if you do not know it yet — it stays “unknown”, not zero.
terms.uploadHint: PDF, PNG or JPG. After the upload the booking moves to “Quote received”.

order.title: Final order
order.empty: You have not fixed a final order yet.
order.noDeltas: No guest changes since you fixed the order.
order.deltasNotice: Answers changed after the final order: {count}
order.firstHint: Write what you ordered. The number of guests confirmed at this moment is kept beside the order.
order.newVersionHint: The agreed order is not edited: you fix a new version, which also takes in the changes above. Old versions stay.

payments.title: Payments
payments.empty: No payment deadlines yet. Add the advance, the instalments and the final balance, each with its date.
payments.amountHint: Leave it empty if you do not know it yet.
payments.moveIntro: We first show you what changes — the date, whether the payment becomes overdue and the total due per month. Nothing moves until you confirm.
payments.unmarkIntro: A recorded payment stays in the history. If it was marked by mistake, write why you are correcting it.
payments.reasonHint: For example: the bank returned the payment.

link.title: Supplier link
link.description: Through this link the supplier sees only their own booking: the briefing, the final order and the deliveries. They see no prices, guests or other suppliers, and they need no account.
link.hashedNote: The link cannot be shown again: we keep it only in hashed form. If you lost it, generate a new one — the old one stops working.
link.onceBody: Copy it now and send it to the supplier. We cannot show it a second time.
link.revokeBody: The link stops working at once. You can generate a new one at any time.

remove.title: Delete the supplier
remove.body: You can delete a supplier added by mistake. If it already has a published briefing, a final order or a payment made, cancel the booking instead of deleting it.
remove.confirmBody: {name} disappears from the occasion, together with its payment deadlines.

errors.email: Write a valid email address, for example name@company.ro.
errors.phone: Write a valid phone number, for example 0722 123 456.
errors.amount: Write the amount in digits, for example 1500 or 1.500,50.
errors.quoteFile: We could not find the uploaded file. Upload the quote again.
errors.cannotDelete: The supplier already has a briefing, a final order or a payment made. Cancel the booking instead of deleting it.
errors.itemLabel: Write what you ordered on every line.
errors.itemQuantity: Write the quantity in digits, on every line.
errors.itemsRequired: Add at least one line to the order.
errors.itemsTooMany: The order has too many lines. Group them.
errors.sameDay: The payment is already due on this day. Choose another date.
errors.paidLocked: The payment is marked as paid. Correct it first if that was a mistake.
errors.notPaid: The payment is not marked as paid.

whatif.moveTitle: You are moving a payment to {supplier}
whatif.amountUnknown: The amount of this payment is unknown.
whatif.monthHasUnknown: The month also includes payments with an unknown amount.

lifecycle.toNotify: To be told the new date

suppliers.title: Suppliers (CSV)
suppliers.description: The suppliers, their contacts and the state of each booking.

payments.title: Supplier payments (CSV)
payments.description: The payment deadlines, the amounts and what has been paid.
